title: history (M6): the session log, the dose-trajectory chart, export and import
body:

UI only, not compiled here. Assembly: the History control moved from a toolbar the entry screen's own navigation bar hides into the shell's control row beside Settings (`App/RootTabs.swift`). No blind test edited.
